records.confidence_note: N figure (40 kg N per t wheat) is a direct GRDC/SARDI budget benchmark; fertiliser rate derived as 40 x typical Australian dryland yield 2-4 t/ha. P/K values are replacement budgets from GRDC-published CSBP removal tables (3 kg P, 4 kg K per t grain), not flat application trials.
records.notes: GRDC GroundCover (SARDI, Dr Peter Hayman): budgets based on 1 t of wheat requiring 40 kg N; N fertiliser = target yield x 40 minus soil mineral N + mineralisation. Typical Australian dryland wheat 2-4 t/ha gives 80-160 kg N/ha before soil credits. P/K: GRDC barley-western nutrition section (citing CSBP) gives wheat removal of 21 kg N, 3 kg P, 4 kg K per t grain (straw: 4-6 N, 0.5-1 P, 9-10 K) - use for replacement budgeting; P 3 kg/t = 6.9 kg P2O5/t, K 4 kg/t = 4.8 kg K2O/t.
records.region_note: GRDC/SARDI national benchmark; removal table from GRDC Western GrowNotes
records.source_title: Weighing nitrogen fertiliser options in an uncertain future (GroundCover); GRDC GrowNotes Barley Western, Section 5 Nutrition and fertiliser (CSBP removal table)

records.confidence_note: GRDC GrowNotes barley tables give crop removal and trial N data (4 t/ha @11.5% protein uses ~144 kg N/ha); fertiliser ranges derived for 2-4 t/ha typical dryland yields. P/K are replacement budgets from the published removal table.
records.notes: GRDC barley GrowNotes: barley has somewhat lower N fertiliser requirements than wheat; a 4 t/ha barley crop at 11.5% protein uses ~144 kg/ha of N (~36 kg N/t). Range 72-144 kg N/ha assumes 2-4 t/ha typical yields, adjusted down for soil N. P/K from GRDC barley-western table (CSBP): barley removal 21 kg N, 3 kg P, 4.5 kg K per t grain. P 3 kg/t = 6.9 kg P2O5/t; K 4.5 kg/t = 5.4 kg K2O/t. Malting barley: avoid excess N (protein penalties), but GRDC gives no single flat rate.
records.region_note: GRDC Western region GrowNotes barley (June 2017)
records.source_title: GRDC GrowNotes Barley - Western Region, Section 5: Nutrition and fertiliser

records.confidence_note: N range combines GRDC northern NSW trial results (40-100 kg N/ha economical responses) with the OCP Victorian budget formula (72 kg N/ha per t target yield); fertiliser N must be reduced by soil mineral N and mineralisation. P is a direct GRDC recommendation (15-20 kg P/ha).
records.notes: GRDC Canola GrowNotes North (March 2017): five years of central-west NSW research showed large economical responses to 40-100 kg N/ha; NGA research supports total crop-available N target ~80 kg N/ha per t grain. GRDC '20 Tips for profitable canola: Victoria' (Dec 2019, CSIRO/NSW DPI/GRDC): budget 72 kg N/ha per t/ha target yield (70-80 kg N/t stated in critical-period section); worked scenarios gave 33-98 kg N/ha applied. P: with grain removal ~10 kg P/ha, application of ~15-20 kg P/ha appears warranted (x2.291 = 34-46 kg P2O5/ha). K: no flat rate; grain removes ~9 kg K/t - replace per soil test.
records.region_note: GRDC Northern region (NSW) GrowNotes + GRDC Victoria OCP project (CSIRO/NSW DPI)
records.source_title: GrowNote Canola North - Section 5: Nutrition and fertiliser (March 2017); 20 Tips for profitable canola: Victoria (December 2019)

records.confidence_note: CottonInfo NUTRIpak is the cotton industry's official nutrition guide (Cotton Australia + CRDC, a federal statutory RDC). N rate is a reference budget; P/K values are removal budgets (per-bale removal x typical 8-10 bale/ha irrigated yields), not direct rate trials.
records.notes: NUTRIpak 2018 N cycle: reference N budget 180 kg/ha; 7-12 kg N/bale removed by crop. Australian Cotton CRC research (Namoi Valley, 5-10 bales/ha): net plant uptake of ~110 kg N/ha sufficient for maximum yield; soils high in N may need only ~50 kg N/ha, very deficient soils may require >180 kg N/ha. Split application preferred for rates >150 kg N/ha. P/K: NUTRIpak Table 1.2 - max whole-crop uptake N 232, P 49, K 312 kg/ha (Rochester et al. 2012); per-bale removal N 11, P 2, K 6 kg/bale. P 2 kg/bale = 4.6 kg P2O5/bale; K 6 kg/bale = 7.2 kg K2O/bale; 8-10 bales/ha gives P2O5 37-46, K2O 58-72. Soil-test driven; K responses common on sodic/dispersive soils.
records.region_note: CottonInfo NUTRIpak (national); N uptake research Namoi Valley NSW
records.source_org: CottonInfo (Cotton Australia) / Cotton Research and Development Corporation (CRDC)
records.source_title: NUTRIpak - A practical guide to cotton nutrition (2018)

records.confidence_note: Direct GRDC GrowNotes figures: total crop N requirements by yield (85/130/150 kg N for 3.5/5.2/6 t/ha), commercial application range 0-150 kg N/ha, and grain P removal. P application rate derived as replacement of stated removal.
records.notes: GRDC Sorghum GrowNotes North (Feb 2017), Section 5.2: total N requirements of 85 kg N for 3.5 t/ha, 130 kg N/ha for 5.2 t/ha, 150 kg N/ha for 6 t/ha; applications to commercial grain sorghum can vary from 0 to 150 kg N/ha depending on soil N. P: 12 kg P removed in grain for a 5.2 t/ha crop (equates to 60 kg MAP); guide says in practice such a high rate may not be needed - rate depends on soil test and P history (12 kg P = 27.5 kg P2O5, ~5.3 kg P2O5/t; 3-6 t/ha gives 16-32 kg P2O5/ha). K: no flat recommendation.
records.region_note: GRDC Northern region (QLD/northern NSW) GrowNotes sorghum
records.source_title: GRDC GrowNotes Sorghum - Northern Region, Section 5: Nutrition and fertiliser

records.confidence_note: Direct GRDC GrowNotes rate tables: 7-16 kg P/ha for 1.5-3.5 t/ha on alkaline soils with good fertiliser history; starter N 5-10 kg/ha safe for nodulation. No official K application rate - most black/red soils K-sufficient.
records.notes: GRDC Chickpea GrowNotes South (July 2017), Section 5: if chickpeas effectively nodulate they should not normally need N fertiliser; starter N 5-10 kg/ha may help early vigour where soil N is low or sowing late (not essential; higher N restricts nodulation). P: 'In order to match the nutrient requirement of a crop yielding 1.5-3.5 t/ha, a guide for alkaline soils with a good fertiliser history is 7-16 kg/ha of phosphorus' (=16-37 kg P2O5/ha; equivalent to 80-186 kg/ha single super). Crop removal: 3.2-3.4 kg P/t grain, ~6.5 kg P/ha for 2 t/ha. K: sufficient in most black/red soils; apply only on low-K sands (<50 ppm) per soil test - no flat rate given.
records.region_note: GRDC Southern region (VIC/SA/southern NSW) chickpea GrowNotes
records.source_title: GrowNote Chickpea South - Section 5: Nutrition and fertiliser (July 2017)
